data.long_meaning: Ashaaya is a Sanskrit name that means 'hope' or 'expectation'. In Hindu mythology, Ashaaya is the personification of hope and is believed to bring prosperity and good fortune. It is also a popular name for babies in Hindu families. The name Ashaaya carries the meaning “Hope, Expectation” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Ashaaya usually hope their child will grow to embody hope, expectation and live with faith, good character and purpose.
